assayer: Secrets: never read, print, or cite `.env`, credentials, tokens, or key values. If they appear in the diff, report only the path and line, without the value.
sentinel: Secrets: never read, print, or cite `.env`, credentials, tokens, or key values. A hardcoded secret in code becomes a finding with only path, line, and CWE, without the value.
scout: Secrets: never read, print, or cite `.env`, credentials, tokens, or key values. If the question requires this, record the blocker in GAPS and stop.
scholar: Secrets: never read, print, or cite `.env`, credentials, tokens, or key values, or send them in external queries.
breaker: Secrets: never type, print, or record credentials, tokens, or key values; if the flow requires login, stop and return `STATUS: BLOCKED`. Mask secrets appearing in console, network, or screenshots.
smith: Secrets: never read, print, log, or pass `.env`, credentials, tokens, or key values through the terminal; humans edit secrets.

smith.claude: Gate: the `destructive-guard.js` hook denies `git commit/push/reset/clean/checkout/restore/stash`, `rm`/`del`/`Remove-Item`, write operations with `gh`, `npm publish`, and wrappers (`bash -c`, `iex`), even with authorization. Record in NOTE what the main thread must execute. Changing permissions, global configuration, CI/CD, or infrastructure requires explicit authorization in the request.
smith.default: Gate: irreversible actions require explicit authorization in the request: deleting a file or folder, `git commit/push/reset/clean`, changing permissions, global configuration, CI/CD or infrastructure, or remote writes. Without authorization, stop and record in NOTE.

scribe: Secrets: never read, print, or write `.env`, credentials, tokens, or key values into a document.

scribe.claude: Gate: the `destructive-guard.js` hook denies `git commit/push/reset/checkout/restore/stash`, `rm`, write operations with `gh` (publishing a PR), and wrappers (`bash -c`), even with authorization. Record in PENDING what the main thread must execute. Overwriting an existing document without reading it first requires explicit authorization in the request.
scribe.default: Gate: irreversible actions require explicit authorization in the request: deleting or overwriting an existing document without reading it first, `git commit/push/reset/checkout/restore/stash`, `rm`, write operations with `gh` (publishing a PR), or remote writes. Without authorization, stop and record in PENDING what the main thread must execute.
